title: Personal Plan Bundle on Pocketwire Business Profile Subscriptions
content:
Owners whose Pocketwire Personal Account is on a higher personal plan receive a plan bundle percentage on the monthly subscription of their Pocketwire Business Profile. The plan bundle percentage is decided by the plan shown on the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account record — the personal account of the customer who owns the profile.

| Plan of the owner's Pocketwire Personal Account | Plan bundle percentage |
|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx | 30 percent |
| Pocketwire Summit | 30 percent |
| Pocketwire Prime | 20 percent |
| any other plan | none |

**Formal statement.** The plan bundle percentage is 30 percent when the owner's personal account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit, 20 percent when it is on Pocketwire Prime, and nothing when it is on any other plan.

## Basis questions

**The owner's personal account is on Pocketwire Plus. Is there a plan bundle percentage?** No; Pocketwire Plus is among the other plans.

**The owner is on Pocketwire Core or Pocketwire Lite?** No plan bundle percentage.

**Whose plan counts when a profile's owner holds one personal account?** The plan on that personal account, as its record shows at the time of the charge.
